supportingHero.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Supporting hero illustration for Bestday Life Audit. Eight simple flat brand-yellow #FFDE59 pictogram people arranged evenly in a circular ring, each holding the rim of one large simple wheel at the centre, viewed straight-on as a clean graphic emblem. Match Bestday's existing faceless circle-head, capsule-torso, rounded capsule limbs pictograms. All eight distinct people must read clearly at small size, with generous spacing and equal visual weight. Wheel is a simple thick yellow circular rim, no chart, no numbers, no text. Flat solid yellow only, no outlines, gradients, shadows, texture, faces or fingers. Square transparent canvas with even 12 percent margins. Transparent background.
